Simplicitor third-party notices
=============================

Simplicitor uses the separately licensed libraries listed in inventory.json.
Their original license, copyright and notice files accompany this document.
Simplicitor 2.0.0 onward uses MIT; its LICENSE is beside the third_party folder.
These notices do not change that license or restrict rights granted by the
third-party licenses.

Qt, PySide6 and Shiboken
-----------------------
Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and their respective contributors.
Qt Core, GUI, Widgets, Network, SVG, Image Formats and PDF are used with
PySide6/Shiboken under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3.
Copies of LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 are included under qt/qtbase/LICENSES/.
Qt's separately licensed third-party components have their original
attributions and license texts under qt/. sources.json records exact upstream
URLs and checksums, including Qt PDF's Chromium/PDFium source revision.
The Qt notice set is a conservative superset of platform-specific components.

The standalone distribution uses Qt/PySide shared libraries. Interface-compatible
modified libraries can replace the corresponding DLLs/PYD files. Modification
and reverse engineering for debugging those library modifications are permitted
under their LGPL terms. Build instructions and application source are available
at https://github.com/alexnosx/Simplicitor. Qt and PySide source versions are at
https://github.com/qt and https://github.com/pyside/pyside-setup; the exact Qt
version and source links are recorded in qt/sources.json.

Other runtime components
------------------------
Python distribution licenses and Windows-binary conditions are in
python-runtime/LICENSE.txt. Python source: https://www.python.org/downloads/source/.
Installed Python library versions and original license filenames are recorded
in inventory.json. Their license texts are under python/.

OpenSSL is used by Python and may also be embedded in cryptography. Copyright
(C) the OpenSSL Project Authors and contributors, 1998-2026. OpenSSL 3 is
licensed under Apache License 2.0, included under qt/qtbase/LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt.
Source and notices: https://github.com/openssl/openssl. The Python OpenSSL
version is recorded in inventory.json; cryptography's own licenses also accompany it.

Generated native code uses the Nuitka runtime. Its license, runtime exception
and notice are under nuitka-runtime/; source: https://github.com/Nuitka/Nuitka.

Microsoft Visual C++ runtime files are Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation.
Their redistribution conditions are described in the Python Windows-binary
license and at https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/vs2022-cruntime/.

This notice bundle supplies attributions and license texts. Publishing remains
subject to the project's explicit release authorization.
